055  private static final Path ROOT_DIR = new Path("/backup/root");
056  private static final String BACKUP_ID = "123";
057
058  @Test
059  public void testRootDirManifestPathConversion() throws IOException {
060    Path manifestPath =
061      HBackupFileSystem.getManifestPath(new Configuration(), ROOT_DIR, BACKUP_ID, false);
062    Path convertedRootDir = HBackupFileSystem.getRootDirFromBackupPath(manifestPath, BACKUP_ID);
063    assertEquals(ROOT_DIR, convertedRootDir);
064  }
065
066  // This test verifies the .tmp directory is skipped over when each subdirectory in the backup
067  // root dir is searched for its .backup.manifest file.
068  @Test
069  public void testGetAllBackupImagesSkipsTmpDir(@TempDir java.nio.file.Path tempDir)
070    throws IOException {
071    Configuration conf = new Configuration();
072    Path backupRootPath = new Path(tempDir.toUri());
073    FileSystem fs = FileSystem.get(backupRootPath.toUri(), conf);
074
075    TableName[] tables = new TableName[] { TableName.valueOf("test_table") };
076    String backupId1 = "backup_0001";
077    String backupId2 = "backup_0002";
078
079    BackupInfo info1 =
080      new BackupInfo(backupId1, BackupType.FULL, tables, backupRootPath.toString());
081    new BackupManifest(info1).store(conf);
082
083    BackupInfo info2 =
084      new BackupInfo(backupId2, BackupType.INCREMENTAL, tables, backupRootPath.toString());
085    new BackupManifest(info2).store(conf);
086
087    fs.mkdirs(new Path(backupRootPath, ".tmp"));
088
089    // Use fully-qualified Log4j2 names to avoid banned-import enforcer rule
090    org.apache.logging.log4j.core.Appender mockAppender =
091      mock(org.apache.logging.log4j.core.Appender.class);
092    when(mockAppender.getName()).thenReturn("mockAppender");
093    when(mockAppender.isStarted()).thenReturn(true);
094    org.apache.logging.log4j.core.Logger log4jLogger =
095      (org.apache.logging.log4j.core.Logger) org.apache.logging.log4j.LogManager
096        .getLogger(HBackupFileSystem.class);
097    log4jLogger.addAppender(mockAppender);
098
099    try {
100      List<BackupImage> images = HBackupFileSystem.getAllBackupImages(conf, backupRootPath);
101
102      // The backupRoot/.tmp dir should not be checked for a .backup.manifest file because it will
103      // not have one. Verify an ERROR is not logged with the following message:
104      // Cannot load backup manifest from: /path/to/.tmp
105      verify(mockAppender, never())
106        .append(argThat((org.apache.logging.log4j.core.LogEvent event) -> event.getLevel()
107          .equals(org.apache.logging.log4j.Level.ERROR)
108          && event.getMessage().getFormattedMessage().contains("Cannot load backup manifest from: ")
109          && event.getMessage().getFormattedMessage().contains(".tmp")));
110
111      assertEquals(2, images.size());
112      assertEquals(backupId2, images.get(0).getBackupId());
113      assertEquals(backupId1, images.get(1).getBackupId());
114    } finally {
115      log4jLogger.removeAppender(mockAppender);
116    }
117  }
118
119  // Verifies a failure to create a .backup.complete file in a completed backup directory does
120  // not cause the backup to fail
121  @Test
122  public void testWriteBackupCompleteMarkerFailsGracefully(@TempDir java.nio.file.Path tempDir)
123    throws IOException {
124    Configuration conf = new Configuration();
125    // Tell hadoop to use MarkerCreationFailFileSystem instead of the default LocalFileSystem
126    // whenever a file:// URI is resolved
127    conf.setClass("fs.file.impl", MarkerCreationFailFileSystem.class, FileSystem.class);
128    // Disable cache to force Hadoop to instantiate a fresh filesystem. If LocalFileSystem is
129    // cached, then Hadoop will use that instead of MarkerCreationFailFileSystem
130    conf.setBoolean("fs.file.impl.disable.cache", true);
131
132    String backupRootDir = tempDir.toUri().toString();
133    String backupId = "backup_fail_marker";
134
135    // Create the backup directory so the path is valid
136    Path backupDir = HBackupFileSystem.getBackupPath(backupRootDir, backupId);
137    FileSystem realFs = FileSystem.getLocal(new Configuration());
138    realFs.mkdirs(backupDir);
139
140    // This should NOT throw -- marker creation is best-effort
141    HBackupFileSystem.writeBackupCompleteMarker(conf, backupRootDir, backupId);
142
143    // Marker should not exist since create() was intercepted
144    assertBackupCompleteFileDoesNotExist(new Configuration(), backupRootDir, backupId);
145  }
146
147  @Test
148  public void testDeleteBackupCompleteMarker(@TempDir java.nio.file.Path tempDir)
149    throws IOException {
150    Configuration conf = new Configuration();
151    String backupRootDir = tempDir.toUri().toString();
152    String backupId = "backup_delete_marker";
153
154    HBackupFileSystem.writeBackupCompleteMarker(conf, backupRootDir, backupId);
155    assertBackupCompleteFileExists(conf, backupRootDir, backupId);
156
157    HBackupFileSystem.deleteBackupCompleteMarker(conf, backupRootDir, backupId);
158    assertBackupCompleteFileDoesNotExist(conf, backupRootDir, backupId);
159
160    // Deleting a marker that does not exist is a no-op
161    HBackupFileSystem.deleteBackupCompleteMarker(conf, backupRootDir, backupId);
162  }
163
164  // Verifies a failure to delete the marker is surfaced, so callers do not go on to delete backup
165  // data while leaving a marker behind
166  @Test
167  public void testDeleteBackupCompleteMarkerFailureThrows(@TempDir java.nio.file.Path tempDir)
168    throws IOException {
169    String backupRootDir = tempDir.toUri().toString();
170    String backupId = "backup_delete_marker_fail";
171    HBackupFileSystem.writeBackupCompleteMarker(new Configuration(), backupRootDir, backupId);
172
173    Configuration conf = new Configuration();
174    conf.setClass("fs.file.impl", MarkerDeletionFailFileSystem.class, FileSystem.class);
175    conf.setBoolean("fs.file.impl.disable.cache", true);
176
177    assertThrows(IOException.class,
178      () -> HBackupFileSystem.deleteBackupCompleteMarker(conf, backupRootDir, backupId));
179    assertBackupCompleteFileExists(new Configuration(), backupRootDir, backupId);
180  }
181
182  // Verifies backup delete cleanup aborts without deleting any data if the marker cannot be
183  // removed, and propagates the failure so the caller does not delete the backup's metadata
184  @Test
185  public void testBackupDataCleanupAbortsWhenMarkerDeleteFails(@TempDir java.nio.file.Path tempDir)
186    throws IOException {
187    String backupRootDir = tempDir.toUri().toString();
188    BackupInfo info = createBackupWithMarkerAndData(backupRootDir, "backup_cleanup_marker_fail");
189
190    assertThrows(IOException.class,
191      () -> BackupUtils.cleanupBackupData(info, createMarkerDeletionFailConf()));
192    assertMarkerAndDataRemain(backupRootDir, info);
193  }
194
195  // Verifies failed-backup recovery aborts before any destructive step if the marker cannot be
196  // removed: no snapshots are deleted, the backup system table is not restored (which would remove
197  // the RUNNING backup record), and no backup data is deleted. This leaves the failed backup
198  // discoverable so repair can retry.
199  @Test
200  public void testFailedBackupRecoveryAbortsBeforeDestructiveStepsWhenMarkerDeleteFails(
201    @TempDir java.nio.file.Path tempDir) throws IOException {
202    String backupRootDir = tempDir.toUri().toString();
203    BackupInfo info = createBackupWithMarkerAndData(backupRootDir, "backup_failed_marker_fail");
204    info.setPhase(BackupPhase.SNAPSHOTCOPY);
205    Connection conn = mock(Connection.class);
206
207    assertThrows(IOException.class, () -> TableBackupClient.cleanupAndRestoreBackupSystem(conn,
208      info, createMarkerDeletionFailConf()));
209    verifyNoInteractions(conn);
210    assertMarkerAndDataRemain(backupRootDir, info);
211  }
212
213  private static BackupInfo createBackupWithMarkerAndData(String backupRootDir, String backupId)
214    throws IOException {
215    TableName table = TableName.valueOf("test_table");
216    BackupInfo info =
217      new BackupInfo(backupId, BackupType.FULL, new TableName[] { table }, backupRootDir);
218    Path tableBackupDir =
219      new Path(HBackupFileSystem.getTableBackupDir(backupRootDir, backupId, table));
220    FileSystem fs = FileSystem.getLocal(new Configuration());
221    fs.mkdirs(tableBackupDir);
222    fs.create(new Path(tableBackupDir, "data")).close();
223    HBackupFileSystem.writeBackupCompleteMarker(new Configuration(), backupRootDir, backupId);
224    assertBackupCompleteFileExists(new Configuration(), backupRootDir, backupId);
225    return info;
226  }
227
228  private static void assertMarkerAndDataRemain(String backupRootDir, BackupInfo info)
229    throws IOException {
230    Configuration conf = new Configuration();
231    assertBackupCompleteFileExists(conf, backupRootDir, info.getBackupId());
232    for (TableName table : info.getTableNames()) {
233      Path tableBackupDir =
234        new Path(HBackupFileSystem.getTableBackupDir(backupRootDir, info.getBackupId(), table));
235      assertTrue(FileSystem.getLocal(conf).exists(new Path(tableBackupDir, "data")));
236    }
237  }
238
239  private static Configuration createMarkerDeletionFailConf() {
240    Configuration conf = new Configuration();
241    conf.setClass("fs.file.impl", MarkerDeletionFailFileSystem.class, FileSystem.class);
242    conf.setBoolean("fs.file.impl.disable.cache", true);
243    return conf;
244  }
245
246  public static class MarkerDeletionFailFileSystem extends FilterFileSystem {
247    public MarkerDeletionFailFileSystem() {
248      super(new LocalFileSystem());
249    }
250
251    @Override
252    public boolean delete(Path f, boolean recursive) throws IOException {
253      if (f.getName().equals(HBackupFileSystem.BACKUP_COMPLETE_FILE_NAME)) {
254        return false;
255      }
256      return super.delete(f, recursive);
257    }
258  }
259
260  public static class MarkerCreationFailFileSystem extends FilterFileSystem {
261    public MarkerCreationFailFileSystem() {
262      super(new LocalFileSystem());
263    }
264
265    @Override
266    public FSDataOutputStream create(Path f, boolean overwrite) throws IOException {
267      if (f.getName().equals(HBackupFileSystem.BACKUP_COMPLETE_FILE_NAME)) {
268        throw new IOException("Injected failure for marker creation test");
269      }
270      return super.create(f, overwrite);
271    }
272  }
273}
